currentGenerationState.source: the P:12 final adjudication (9986441) plus the four-entry replacement ledger, re-derived in this step with the landed harness; not memory

replacementAssignment.method: landed planPendingReplacementObligations(draw, ledger, [12, 10]) - input deliberately unsorted to prove the sort is the planner's

replacementSplits.rule: a replacement inherits its selection slot's split; the draw's reserve entries carry no split field

nextUntouchedPrimaries.rule: untouched primary selection slots in ascending selectionIndex (frozen draw order)
nextUntouchedPrimaries.p13P14InheritedFromPausedWindowV2: P:13 and P:14 were precommitted in Window V2 but never started (Window V2 terminal PAUSE_P5_LOW_RAW_YIELD, not reopened); they are untouched primaries and re-enter only through this new precommitment

windowSize.source: Corpus Plan V1 batchingPlan.recommendedBatchSize = 5; no Plan V1 amendment changes it
windowSize.purpose: bounded live institution contact (about 5 x 60 = 300 requests) followed by human inspection

strategyOptions.name: REPLACEMENTS_ONLY
strategyOptions.assessment: clears both owed obligations and preserves reserve order, but uses 2 of the recommended 5 slots, so it spends a full human-review cycle on a smaller batch than Plan V1 recommends and advances no untouched primary

strategyOptions.name: PRIMARIES_ONLY
strategyOptions.assessment: size 5 and frozen primary order hold, but it defers two already-owed replacement obligations past a further window; no rule forbids that, but it leaves known obligations outstanding while new ones may accrue

strategyOptions.name: MIXED_2_REPLACEMENTS_PLUS_3_PRIMARIES
strategyOptions.assessment: clears every currently owed replacement obligation in the next bounded precommit, still advances untouched primaries, uses the recommended size 5, preserves frozen reserve order and frozen primary order, is result-blind and needs no adaptive insertion; same shape as the owner-ratified Window V1 (replacements first, then primaries)

strategyOptions.name: OTHER_COMPLIANT_ORDERINGS
examples: primaries before replacements inside the same five items
strategyOptions.methodologicallyAllowed: the first is allowed but departs from the Window V1 precedent; the second would leave one owed obligation deferred with no governance reason to split them

comparisonBasis: methodology and governance fit only; no institution identity, website, expected yield or split preference was consulted

orderRationale: replacements already owed by frozen methodology come first
multiple replacement obligations are ordered by ascending selectionIndex
untouched primaries then continue in frozen selection order
the combined order is also ascending selectionIndex across all five items: 10, 12, 13, 14, 15
no split or identity characteristic is consulted
all five items are precommitted before any future network execution
candidateWindow.drawEntryDigestMethod: drawEntrySha256 = sha256(canonicalStringify(exact parsed draw entry)), landed drawEntrySha256 over canonicalStringify (src/orgunits/classify/canonical.ts); replacements digest draw.reserve[reserveRankPosition], primaries digest draw.selection[selectionIndex]

scratchSpecCheck.whyNotUsedToMaterialiseAPlan: a spec hand-assembled in a scratch script is not an independent governance -> spec path; see planMaterialisation

newWindowStartingPauseState.source: Owner Clarification Q4 (window-local P1/P2/P3/P5/P8, generation-global P6)

replacementFailure: the failed reserve remains the current occupant of that slot
a new replacement obligation for the SAME selectionIndex arises only after evidence adjudication
reserve 6 or later is NOT dynamically assigned inside the same window
the next reserve assignment waits for a later precommitted window
primaryFailure: assign no reserve inside the same window
a pending replacement obligation arises only after adjudication
replacement assignment occurs in a later precommitted window
failureSemantics.source: Owner Clarification Q2 (same-slot append-only chain across precommitted windows)

pauseBeforeStartReserveSemantics.futureLivePrecommit: if both ledger rows are appended, committed and pushed before request #1, both reserves become consumed and current occupants at that durable boundary
ifAGatePausesBeforeAReplacementRuns: that reserve remains the current occupant of its slot
it is carried forward as ASSIGNED_NOT_YET_EXECUTED
it is not returned to the pool

strategyOutcomeDetail: The mixed window R:10:4, R:12:5, P:13, P:14, P:15 is methodologically clear, deterministic, result-blind and passes the generic spec validator. The only blocker is the strategy -> PrecommittedWindowSpec adapter being hard-bound to the post-Window-V1 strategy.
